landing.title: Domio
landing.subtitle: Interactive decks, shared sessions, and live presentations.
landing.features.editor.title: Editor
landing.features.editor.body: Build reactive decks with live data sources, branching flows, and brand-aware copy.
landing.features.presenter.title: Presenter
landing.features.presenter.body: Drive live sessions with audience prompts, hand-offs, and offline-friendly rehearsals.
landing.features.viewer.title: Viewer & Join
landing.features.viewer.body: Read-only playback and lightweight audience participation, embeddable anywhere.
landing.builders.heading: For builders
landing.builders.body: See the repository README for setup instructions, the contracts/ directory for the API surface, and the SDK packages under packages/ for the typed clients apps consume.

landing.pluginsSdk.title: Domio Plugin SDK
landing.pluginsSdk.subtitle: Extend the canvas, the editor, and the data layer.
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.heading: Quickstart — scaffold in 5 minutes
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.step1.body: Install the Domio plugin CLI from npm. The CLI ships with a local dev server and the publish command.
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.step2.body: Pick a template — canvas node, data connector, or export format — and the CLI writes the project skeleton for you.
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.step3.body: Fill in definePlugin(...) with the canvas registrations, data bindings, or export pipelines you need.
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.step4.body: Run the dev server against the real editor; your node types, bindings, and exports hot-reload as you iterate.
landing.pluginsSdk.quickstart.step5.body: Cut a release, run the review checklist, and submit. Approved plugins go live on the public marketplace.
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorials.heading: Tutorials
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorial.canvas.title: Canvas plugin
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorial.canvas.body: Add a custom node type to the Domio canvas — register geometry, controls, and a preview thumbnail.
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorial.connector.bo: Stream rows from an external source into deck tables, charts, and reactive bindings.
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorial.export.title: Export format
landing.pluginsSdk.tutorial.export.body: Add a new export target (PDF, SCORM, custom blob) with a streaming encoder pipeline.
